group_note: All six were read from the page as structure=plain and all six are plain_mcq on E1, so the grouping holds; q056 is a borderline case whose four options are each a full claim, but a single plain stem is printed above them, so it stays plain_mcq. One rule was applied across the packet to keep E4 consistent, because these items look alike and v1 split such pairs without saying why: where the stem names a term or criterion and each option is an item whose association with it is one tabulated fact, the demand is recall and the structure is single_step (q052, q053, q055, q058 — the fact 'competition is the (−,−) interaction' decides q058 exactly as 'lemon is axile' decides q053, so the two carry the same labels); where the stem is negated and every option must be graded true or false before one can be chosen, the verdicts are combined and the structure is several_independent_checks (q056, q057). The demand stays recall throughout, since each individual verdict is a stored fact and no rule is applied to a new case. elimination is carried by q052 alone, because only there could one securely-known fact (manganese, not magnesium) be named together with the options it strikes; the other five offer four same-kind options from the same chapter paragraph, so no shortcut was demonstrable and the label was withheld. On E5 the two negated items get true_statement_trap on every true option, naming the polarity as the rulebook requires, while the four direct items get option-specific devices (look-alike metal names, half-true pairs, the wrong retinal site, another table row).
